top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards an original, independently confirmed discovery chain (proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, human incretin physiology) whose consequences are documented in large randomized trials of glycaemia, weight, and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The citation is limited to physiology and the active form, with the therapies as consequence, so the allocation is defensible. The Habener priority question and the omission of Knudsen are real weaknesses but do not outweigh the maturity and impact of the work, so an award is preferred to no award.
